title: fix(runtime): include the production Memories intent adapter
body:
Ordinary DomainService publishing omitted the owner intent adapter, and catalog registration scanned only its declaration assembly. Include the adapter in the normal owner project graph and pass its actual factory assembly to SDK catalog registration.

Enroll DomainService.Tests in the Docker-free unit/contract inventory and its strict coverage contract. Preserve all seven existing projects, the 76.5% threshold, original scopes, trait exclusions and TRX/Cobertura requirements. Require the added report and its exact production assembly source scope; missing reports and unknown projects still fail. Regression controls connect coverage requirements to the executable inventory and retain the inherited MTP configuration. Contributor docs and their existing contract now describe the same eight-project lane.

Release output consumes genuine public SDK 4.1.0 packages; preparation selects genuine Builds 4.44.4. Existing compatibility profiles and publication authorities remain intact.

Validation: all 13 actual DomainService cases and three existing CLI controls passed locally. The new production discovery regression resolves the real factory assembly and its six adapters. The first updated hosted run executed all eight projects with 5,415 passes, including all 13 DomainService cases, but correctly failed the then-incomplete coverage contract. Its authentic reports now pass the corrected configuration at 34,630/42,472 lines (81.54%) against 76.5%. All 40 connected Python coverage/validator/runner tests and missing-eighth/unknown-ninth report controls pass. Fresh complete hosted CI on this final head and normal protected publication remain required.
